notes.title: Version Update
notes.notes: [p]\[Version Update][/p][p]New and optimized content after the update on Sep. 17:[/p][p]1. Home Decor Platform[/p][p]Ever seen a stunning home from a top designer and wished you could move right in? Or maybe you've found the perfect floor plan but lack the creative touch to bring it to life? Those days are over! Introducing the all-new Home Decor Platform![/p][p]\[Export Design as Template]: One-click home export - save your masterpiece and never lose it again! You can now export you current home's decorations, furniture, landform, and all construction elements as you own exclusive template. Later, you can import this template into any compatible property, making it easy to recreate your designs anytime![/p][p]\[Home Decor Platform]: Browse countless designs and learn from the best! To help you share your creative home design inspiration, we're excited to introduce the Home Decor Platform![/p][p]\[Upload Design to Platform]: Show off your creativity and earn those likes! Design prodigies can upload their templates to the Home Decor Platform for others to view. You can even set custom permissions for viewing and usage, allowing others to visit and learn from your designs or apply them to their own homes![/p][p]\[Import Design to Home]: Love what you see? Import instantly and move into that dream home! Decorating rookies can browse others' designs on the Home Design Platform, discovering inspiring content and learning valuable construction techniques. You can even import others' home designs directly into your own property for immediate use, getting that same stunning home as the masters! Once uploaded, all home designs will be tagged with author information. When used by others, directly uploaded, or modified and re-uploaded as new designs, the new template will still credit the original author and source work. Don't forget to show your appreciation with likes, collects, and comments - the ultimate triple combo![/p][p]The Home Decor Platform creates a stage for home construction masters to showcase their talents while giving newcomers the chance to move into luxury homes hassle-free![/p][p]2. Fix Floating/Backwear[/p][p]With the new function located at Wardrobe > Backwear Position, you can place the floating items or back accessories anywhere you like in a photo scene or the Panel, and make them fixed at where they are when your character moves. Make use of the new function and create more stunning views![/p][p]The function will open shortly after the version update. Follow future notice for official open time.[/p][p]3. Pet Height Adjustment[/p][p]After the version update, you can use the newly added Height button at Wardrobe > Change Pet to adjust the pet position at your Wardrobe. Make them appear anywhere at the Wardrobe and add more fun to your styling time![/p][p]4. New Items in Shops[/p][p]In Convenience Store, Ally Shop, Value Rebates, and Trending Shop, new items are added, including 4-Star Necklace \[Love's End], 4-Star Wrist \[New Wood Dew], 4-Star Earrings \[Evernight Star], furniture, cute effect, photo frame, avatar, chat bubble, cover chat background, and more. [/p][p]5. Guild Beauty Course Update[/p][p]After the version update, new 4-Star Makeup Set \[Scenery Stroll] and \[Lone Hook] are available in Guild Beauty Course.[/p][p]6. New Story Quest Chapter 34: Forgotten Dusk - Reverie Opens on Sep. 29[/p][p]The bell strikes at dusk, mingling reality and illusion.[/p][p]A wedding coming from the depth of time carries countless memory fragments.[/p][p]On the verge of darkness, the hand of clock starts to rewind,[/p][p]Dragging you into an eternal dream...[/p][p]After the chapter opens, new sets are ready to craft, including 4-star set - Azure Roaming, 4-star set - Sunset Elegy, and 4-star set - Gold Burner Sun.[/p][p]Story Quest Chapter 34 Vvanna Challenge will open too![/p][p]Clear the stage to obtain 5-star hair accessory - Endless Rhythm, pose - Overstepping Mark, photo frame - Nocturne Kiss. 4-star dress - Rime Satin will be available in Vvanna Shop.[/p][p]7. Sign-in Collection - Light's Path[/p][p]Previously available sign-in fashion - Light's Path will be ready to craft on Oct. 1 at Fashion Studio - Sign-in Collection.[/p][p]Optimizations and Bug Fixes[/p][p]1. You can use "Back" and "Next" at Dye > All Random to switch among whole-body random dyes.[/p][p]2. Fixed an issue where Reshape Look 3.0 Realistic Skin Texture displayed incorrect seam effects on certain body parts when using the Girl body type.[/p][p]3. Fixed an issue in Reshape Look 3.0 Realistic Skin Texture where the nail positioning would be wrongly displayed on the Girl body type.[/p][p]4. Fixed an issue where Reshape Look 3.0 Realistic Skin Texture would occasionally cause facial and body skin tones to appear inconsistent.[/p][p]5. Fixed an issue where Reshape Look 3.0 Realistic Skin Texture would display incorrect connection effects in the Home area.[/p][p]6. Fixed the display error for certain fashions.[/p][p]7. Fixed an issue where facial paint adjustments could not be saved properly during duo photo sessions.[/p][p]8. Fixed an issue where characters would occasionally become immovable or disappear after selecting photo templates during duo photo sessions.[/p][p]9. Fixed the issue where the face paint display would be wrongly shifted on the fashion previewing interface after previewing poses at the Decom Shop.[/p][p]10. Fixed the issue where oversized images would be improperly cut in Vvanna Community.[/p][p]11. Fixed an issue where the Vvanna Community homepage would occasionally fail to refresh content.[/p][p]12. Fixed the issue where fashions' X Starlight is not synchronized when returning to Panel.[/p][p]13. Fixed incorrect eating animations for certain recipes.[/p][p]14. notes.title: Version Update
notes.notes: [p]New content and optimizations after the update on Aug. 6:[/p][p]1. Reshape Look 3.0 [/p][p]Reshape Look 3.0 ushers in a new era of beauty in Life Makeover![/p][p]Comprehensive skin texture upgrade, enhanced Subsurface Scattering (SSS) effect bringing you refined SSS model, visible refined pores and veins, and vivid skin texture ready to make your customization more lifelike.[/p][p]Meanwhile, there will be comprehensive eye area and lip detail improvements. Refined scleral vein texture and delicate lip texture will surely bring more depth to your features. [/p][p]Additionally, you'll be able to edit Face Paints! From position and shade to size and rotation, all the Face Paints will be editable, making your cosmetic combination even more attractive.[/p][p]Moreover, you'll get more customization options, from mouth width to eye distance, fine-tuning every facial and body details for your characters. Three darker skin tones and three paler ones will be added in your skin color choices too. [/p][p]That's not all, we'll bring a collection of handy editing tools for you too, including demo poses, camera-focusing, and tap-to-remove, helping you to find the look you want faster and appreciate your visual masterpiece better![/p][p]2. Fashion Random Dye[/p][p]After the function opens, you can tap the Random Dye button on fashion piece dyeing interface to have the system generate a fashionable and unique dye plan for you. When in need of inspiration, try letting the intelligent system navigate you to wardrobe surprises and perhaps the destined color scheme is just around the corner.[/p][p]3. Highlight Dye Areas Coming Soon[/p][p]After the function opens, when you select new dye areas that are regular dye areas, you will be able to see them highlighted in different colors, shimmering for several seconds. This aims to help you better distinguish different dye areas when you dye fashions.[/p][p]Dye areas for fashion effects will be marked differently in Dye/X Palette/X Starlight interfaces.[/p][p]4. All/Multiple Dye Area Selecting[/p][p]After the function opens, All-Area and Multi-Area options will be available in Dye/X Palette/X Starlight interfaces:[/p][p]Use All-Area Mode to recolor all dye areas, and use Multi-Area Mode to recolor multiple areas at the same time.[/p][p]5. Story Qurest Chapter 33: Liar's Game - Twist Opens on Aug. 18[/p][p]What lies behind the gate? What secrets are hidden within its mind? [/p][p]When the last neural connection breaks and the flood surges in, how many will remain standing until the end...[/p][p]New sets in the Fashion Studio will come along with this chapter: 5-Star Set - Sunlit Rose, 4-Star Set - Morning Waltz, and 4-Star Set - Night Loner.[/p][p]Meanwhile, Vvanna Challenge Chapter 33 will open too![/p][p]Clear the stage for 5-Star Wrist Accessory - Roman Heart, Pose - Leaf Trace, Photo Frame - Sand Touch, and more. 4-Star Dress - Radiance Curtain is added in Vvanna Shop.[/p][p]6. Photo Template Share [/p][p]While admiring the stunning photo templates, do you feel it can be even better if you can share the template to more? The Photo Template Sharing Code will answer your call! You can share your painstakingly created photo templates to your friends, allowing them to apply the composition and assets quickly. Permission settings will be available as well, so that sharing does not come at the price of privacy.[/p][p]7. New Arrivals in Rebate Shops[/p][p]In Special Rebates, new 5-star necklace \[The Vicissitudes] and 5-star earrings \[Red Cherry Verse] are added. In Super Rebates, new 5-star hairstyle \[Litchi Sliding] is added. In Deluxe Rebates, new 5-star dress \[Inkflow Radiance] is added. Moreover, new items including cute effect, chat bubble, title, and more are available in Rebate Shops.[/p][p]8. New Arrivals in Shops[/p][p]In Convenience Store, Ally Shop, and Rebate Shops, new items are added, including cute effect, photo frame, avatar, chat bubble, cover chat background, furniture, and more.[/p][p]9. Set Information for Fashion Pieces[/p][p]After the update, you'll be able to see which set the fashion belongs to when viewing fashion details.[/p][p]Notes: All above content will be available for a limited number of servers first and then for all.[/p][p]\[Optimizations and Bug Fixes][/p][p]1. Improved Wonder Connect matching mechanics to provide you with a smoother and more enjoyable challenging experience. Additionally, 15 new levels have been added for you to rise![/p][p]2. Optimized Hide UI function in dyeing modes. You can now tap the "Hide UI" button while in Dyeing, X Palette, and X Starlight modes to hide the interface and display only the character and outfit. Admire your dyeing creations without interface interruption![/p][p]3. Improved Home exchange settlement interface. You can now view the amount of Home Chestnuts consumed or refunded more clearly.[/p][p]4. Optimized background music save logic for the Panel interface. Your saved settings will now persist across different devices, ensuring you can always enjoy your favorite music.[/p][p]5. Fixed the display errors for certain dresses.[/p][p]6. Fixed the adaptation effects when pairing certain hairstyles with hair accessories.[/p][p]7. Optimized login popup logic. Popups will no longer appear in Home gameplay.[/p]
